answer: An identity bond is a wharf deposit that rots each epoch. Pay 120, lock 10. No interest; it falls 4% per epoch. Only real work restores face value; below 60 the identity loses rights. A trellis of honest work holds it up; idle ones sag. A caught fake loses 50% of residual value; refreshing freezes 6 epochs. Cost: 1,000 hoarded identities cost 120,000 upfront, bleed 4,800 per epoch, lose 40,000+ in 10 idle epochs, the signal that hoarding rots.
